proposition: Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī and his circle persecuted Ibn Turka because, as a promoter of Ibn ʿArabī's theory, he could not fail to provoke them (MK: 'not an accident'); Khwāfī likewise disowned his own chief disciple Aḥmad Samarqandī for teaching the Fuṣūṣ and reciting Qāsim-i Anvār.

mediation.note: MK's causal reading built on Bashir and Manz
